critical_code_review_comments: deps.get_org_user write-block: WRITE_ALLOWED_WHEN_EXPIRED is matched with startswith() on request.url.path which already includes the mounted /api prefix (API router prefix='/api'). Prefixes listed as '/api/subscription', '/api/auth', '/api/support', '/api/events', '/api/onboarding' — matches correctly. Confirmed via test_trial_expired_blocks_writes_and_allows_reads_and_subscription.

analytics.ingest_event rejects any event not in CLIENT_EVENTS and returns 200 {ok:false} rather than 400 — intentional to never break the app, but note that curl -I health-type checks will see 200 even on malformed payloads.

analytics.link_visitor uses $or=None matcher implicit — correct: it only updates events with org_id:None belonging to the given visitor_id, so re-registration with same visitor_id would NOT re-link already-linked events. Good.

analytics.after_change: trial_activated event is created with once=True AND the organisations.activated_at update is conditional on `not org.get('activated_at')` — double-guarded, safe against race conditions in practice (single-user owner).

admin.admin_update_settings activation_rules validation uses `not any(r.values())` to reject all-zero; but if any value is a bool False or None it would also trip — current Pydantic model forces ints so OK.
Landing page: FloatingWhatsApp lacks data-testid='whatsapp-float' which the review implicitly expected for the overlap check (minor).
